evals.prompt: I set up CometChat in my Flutter app and added a UserListener to show online/offline status for contacts. But onUserOnline and onUserOffline never fire — no errors, just silence. What am I missing?
evals.expected_output: Should identify that subscriptionType was not set during init (the silent failure). Must explain that without subscriptionType in AppSettingsBuilder, presence events are silently disabled. Should show the fix: set CometChatSubscriptionType.allUsers (or .roles/.friends) during init.

evals.prompt: I want to add a 'User is typing...' indicator to my Flutter chat screen using CometChat SDK v5. How do I send and receive typing events?
evals.expected_output: Should show CometChat.startTyping(receiverUid:, receiverType:) and CometChat.endTyping(), receiving via MessageListener.onTypingStarted/onTypingEnded with TypingIndicator object. Should mention debouncing startTyping on text input and calling endTyping on send.

evals.prompt: How do I implement read receipts in my CometChat Flutter chat app? I want to show blue ticks when the other person has read my messages.
evals.expected_output: Should show CometChat.markAsRead(message) called when chat opens and on new real-time messages, receiving via MessageListener.onMessagesRead with MessageReceipt object containing readAt timestamp. Should mention markAsDelivered for delivery receipts and the group-specific onMessagesReadByAll/onMessagesDeliveredToAll.
